text:
anya_sales: Quick syncTerra Financial wants a 2-week POC: SSO (SAML), SCIM delta for ~50k users, RBAC via groups, and EU data residency. Can we scope blockers?
sam_se: Hosted POC fine for SAML + basic SCIM. For EU residency and SLA we should propose Dedicated in EU. Need expected delta frequency.
liam_ps: Pricing note: 50k with near-real-time deltas likely triggers SCIM-plus + dedicated node. Need cadence to price.
anya_sales: They said active users every 2-5m, others hourly. Also require domain proofing (DNS TXT) and SAML fingerprint pin.
miriam_sec: Regulated finance: must have SOC2, subprocessor list, KMS options, SIEM integration, and 1y audit log retention. Confirm KMS support for Dedicated/Private.
sam_se: For POC plan: 1) Hosted SAML test endpoint, 2) demo SCIM connector with throttle=100 rps, retry/dlq to S3. Share config snippet.
liam_ps: I'll draft quote with Hosted trial + SCIM-plus tier + Dedicated EU appendix and observability retention SKUs.
anya_sales: Terra asks for graceful SCIM failures (queue + retries) not user errors. Supported?
sam_se: Yes  we use durable queues, exp backoff, DLQ. Example: scim.mode=delta, throttle_rps=100, retry=exp_backoff, dead_letter=s3://terra-dlq
miriam_sec: Also need logs with user_id + request_id to SIEM over TLS. Send SOC2 and DPA.
liam_ps: Will include contract addenda for domain proofing and SCIM SLA.
anya_sales: Action items: @sam_se runbook + test vectors, @miriam_sec security artifacts, @liam_ps draft quote. Kickoff Tue 10:00 CET.
sam_se: Runbook by Mon EOD.
miriam_sec: Docs by Mon.
liam_ps: Quote draft Mon EOD.
deploy-bot: POC workspace terra-poc-3150004321 created. SAML endpoint: https://poc.redwood.internal/saml/terra
